title: P membership from uniform circuits
statement: Let $L$ be a language over the Boolean alphabet, and let $C$ be a family of Boolean circuits that is polynomial-time uniform and has fan-in at most two. If the language recognized by $C$ is $L$, then $L$ belongs to polynomial time.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the Boolean alphabet
$C$ is a family of Boolean circuits
Every circuit in $C$ has fan-in at most two
